subject: Supplier change notice: subcontractor addition + DPA alignment for Order 6421
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@orbitsystems.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Support <support@orbitsystems.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier change notice: DataStream onboarding (Order 6421)

Hi Hannah,

Per section 7.2 of our MSA, Orbit needs to notify Redwood of a subcontractor addition on the data ingestion side. We are onboarding DataStream Inc. to handle log ingestion for Order 6421 (short-lived access to S3 logs and aggregated telemetry).

High-level:
- Subcontractor: DataStream Inc. (maria.lopez@datastream.com)
- Scope: log ingestion, transient access to ordered buckets for 30 days, no model training rights
- Controls: TLS in transit, role-based least-privilege, SIEM hooks, access revocation on completion

Attached: Orbit_Supplier_Change_Notice.pdf (1 page summary + table of access).

Please confirm whether Redwood needs a DPA addendum, evidence items (SOC 2, encryption attestations), or an order-form amendment. We are prepared to provide DataStream's SOC2 summary and a signed subcontractor attestation.

Can you advise next steps and target SLA for review? Orbit requests approval within 48 hours to keep the onboarding schedule.

Thanks,

Rajiv Patel
Legal Counsel | Orbit Systems
rajiv.patel@orbitsystems.com
+1 415-555-0183

---
Attachment: Orbit_Supplier_Change_Notice.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier change notice: DataStream onboarding (Order 6421)

Thanks Rajiv — received and flagged.

On first pass: we will need Legal to confirm DPA coverage and Procurement to confirm risk tiering and order-form changes.

Kimberly / Jonas — can you triage? My initial asks: 
- Legal: quick read on whether DataStream requires a DPA addendum and whether Orbit's proposed attestations satisfy our MSA Exhibit B requirements. If DPA addendum required, can you draft a short addendum we can send to Orbit?
- Procurement: confirm whether this is an Order Form amendment (scope change) and if we can sign to allow transient access for 30 days. Also confirm whether we should require an Order Form change to capture vendor-of-record for billing.

I realize Orbit is asking for a 48-hour window. If we can't meet that, propose we offer a conditional approval pending receipt of SOC2 summary + signed subcontractor attestation and document the access period in an amended order form.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:16:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier change notice: DataStream onboarding (Order 6421)

Hannah / Rajiv — I reviewed the notice and attached a short DPA addendum template that would address our data processing expectations for a downstream subprocessor. Key points:

- Add explicit prohibition on training or model access
- Minimum security evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary OR ISO cert + network encryption attestations
- Requirement for 24-hour breach notification and access revocation capability
- Logging and access review: DataStream must provide onboarding evidence and a signed attestation replicating Orbit's obligations under the MSA

I am attaching a draft DPA_addendum_draft.docx. Assuming Orbit can accept the addendum and provide the SOC2 summary, we can issue conditional approval and start the order-form amendment process.

Rajiv — please confirm DataStream's SOC2 window and who at DataStream will sign the attestation. If you can share the SOC2 summary link now, it will speed the review.

kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier change notice: DataStream onboarding (Order 6421)

Hi Kimberly / Hannah — thanks for the quick review.

We can confirm: 
- DataStream is SOC 2 Type II covered (most recent report: Aug 2027). Attestation summary uploaded: https://drive.company.com/secure/DataStream_SOC2_summary.pdf
- Maria Lopez will sign the subcontractor attestation on behalf of DataStream (see contact below)
- DataStream accepts the draft DPA addendum with the model-access prohibition clause as written; they request one minor wording tweak around "retention window" which is included in a redline we can send if needed.

We appreciate the conditional approval path. Orbit requests conditional approval by EOD today to keep engineers on schedule — otherwise the deployment is pushed a week.

Maria Lopez

maria.lopez@datastream.com

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. Orbit confirms DataStream's SOC2 summary is final and they accept the DPA addendum language pending the single retention-window tweak Maria mentioned. We can circulate a redline within 2 hours.

To keep on schedule, Orbit requests conditional approval:
- Condition: signed DataStream attestation + SOC2 summary uploaded to secure drive (done)

If Redwood agrees to those conditions, Orbit will proceed with temporary credentialing and will limit scope to the 30-day window referenced in the notice.
